items.title: Cathie Wood Was Right About These 5 Stocks
items.summary: Cathie Wood became one of Wall Street’s best-known fund managers during the pandemic rally, but her flagship ARK Innovation ETF (BATS:ARKK) fell sharply in 2022 and has trailed the market since. items.title: What investors should know about Anthropic's unusual IPO
items.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — When Anthropic's stock begins trading for the first time later this week, it will be a big test not only for the company behind the Claude AI chatbot but also for the entire artificial-intelligence industry and the U.Anthropic's initial public offering will reverberate far beyond anyone geeky enough to understand what its business structure as a “public benefit corporation” means.
